[05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-25 - audit-journal-path-on-linux [ses_f2593046cffeSSNNiV7jM21XE6].md:L12310] 6. → `ActivityWorker::tick` produces zero events; `repo.insert_raw_events(&events)` writes nothing — `activity/worker.rs:183-184` [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-25 - audit-journal-path-on-linux [ses_f2593046cffeSSNNiV7jM21XE6].md:L12311] 7. → `raw_events` stays empty, so `generation.rs:82-84` yields an empty `events` vec, and `event_summaries` stays empty, producing the literal prompt text `"No recorded activity today."` — `generation.rs:197-198`

nodes.label: Linux capture provider input-density gate
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-25 - audit-journal-path-on-linux [ses_f2593046cffeSSNNiV7jM21XE6].md:L12315] - **No `input_density` events.** On Linux `input_density` is hardcoded `None` (`capture_provider.rs:158`), and `worker.rs:382` only emits an `input_density` event when the sample carries one. Therefore, permanently on Linux: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-25 - audit-journal-path-on-linux [ses_f2593046cffeSSNNiV7jM21XE6].md:L12316] - Input-intensity line never emitted — `fallback_journal.rs:217-236` [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-25 - audit-journal-path-on-linux [ses_f2593046cffeSSNNiV7jM21XE6].md:L12317] - Webcam/"Deep Reading" presence never detected — `fallback_journal.rs:239-247` and `fallback_journal.rs:435-443` [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-25 - audit-journal-path-on-linux [ses_f2593046cffeSSNNiV7jM21XE6].md:L12318] - `classify_focus_session` can never reach `DeepWork` (requires `keystrokes >= 100` on an `input_density` event) — `derived_tracker.rs:101-122`

nodes.label: derive_focus_session gated on queue items
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-25 - audit-journal-path-on-linux [ses_f2593046cffeSSNNiV7jM21XE6].md:L12320] - **No screenshots / no queue items → no derived sessions.** `screenshot_ref_hash` is always `None` on Linux (`capture_provider.rs:159`), so `upsert_queue_item` is never reached (`worker.rs:187-205`). `commit_pending_queue` early-returns when `items.is_empty()` (`worker.rs:242-244`) **before** the `derive_focus_session` / `insert_derived_session` block at `worker.rs:249-253`. Result on Linux: `derived_sessions` is always empty, `semantic_cluster` is always `""` (`generation.rs:149-156`), and `computed_dominant_state` always falls back to the hardcoded `"deep_work"` (`generation.rs:145-147`).

nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-25 - audit-journal-path-on-linux [ses_f2593046cffeSSNNiV7jM21XE6].md:L12323] - **`dominant_state` is stored with a non-canonical key.** `generation.rs:136-137` builds it via `format!("{:?}", s.focus_session_type).to_lowercase()` → `"deepwork"`, `"meetingheavy"`, `"lightwork"`. Only `"distracted"` and `"recovery"` happen to be valid keys in `JOURNAL_STATE_KEYS` (`generation.rs:7-13`). `"deepwork"` etc. match neither `stateIcon` (`journalHelpers.ts:5-11`) nor `stateColors` (`JournalList.tsx:63-71`), so the badge degrades to the hash fallback (`journalHelpers.ts:13-22`) and the raw string is displayed at `JournalList.tsx:173`.

nodes.label: Wayland clipboard read requests image/png only
nodes.norm_label: wayland clipboard read requests image/png only
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-25 - perbaikan-paste-gambar-di-opencode [ses_f26497020ffeWRs5OjcrDoP42Q].md:L5710] And another: maybe the user's clipboard image is a **WebP/JPEG** and... no, arboard requests image/png specifically! If the clipboard offers ONLY `image/jpeg` (e.g. copying a JPEG from some app) → wl-clipboard-rs finds no image/png → NoMimeType → nothing pasted. And opencode's preferredTypes ["image/png","text/plain"] confirms PNG-only. THAT could be it if they copy a JPEG screenshot... but screenshots are PNG.
